title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This result has far exceeded my expectations! Think of all the experiments I can use these plushies in!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For instance, I could equip each one with AI modeled after different Umamusume and use motor technology to conduct tabletop scrimmages simulating real races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you showing sympathy for inorganic objects? You really are an interesting guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'll make a display with the plushies! In exchange, let me study your emotional instability!
